name: Context ingestion agent
job: Pulls every connected source on its own schedule, cleans and classifies records, and keeps the context layer fresh.

name: Reviews & social listening
job: Scans app-store reviews, survey verbatims and social mentions, clusters emerging themes, and routes them to the signals agent.

name: Competitive & regulatory intelligence
job: Crawls competitor fares, launches and policy changes plus the DOT regulatory feed, and adds them to the context layer.

name: Signals agent
job: Clusters records into themes, scores each one on volume, trend, reach and strategic fit, and publishes the capped, ranked list to Signals.
guardrail: Ranking rules are visible and editable

name: Governance check agent
job: Reads every opportunity and prototype version against the policy text, triggers the matching gates, and writes each result to the gate log.
guardrail: Can flag or block, never approve

name: Customer email triage & reply
job: Answers routine Customer Care email (receipts, seat changes, baggage status) and drafts a reply for anything that needs a human.

name: Booking & rebooking assistant
job: The live chatbot on web and app: helps customers search fares, compare alternates when a flight sells out, and rebook.

name: IROPS proactive rebooking
job: Watches the ops feed for delays and cancellations and offers impacted customers the best rebooking option before they call.

name: Baggage status responder
job: Answers "where's my bag" inquiries with live tracking status. Paused while the bag-tracking source is reconnected.
